t.zh: <level-ref to="1B4"></level-ref>只要一个物体清晰。这一关有两个标记，近处的在 1200 mm，远处的在 2000 mm；透镜对焦在 1500 mm，不能动。光圈这回用摄影的写法给出：<wiki-ref to="f-number"></wiki-ref>是焦距除以光圈直径，50 mm 镜头的 f/2 就是 25 mm 的光圈。
t.en: <level-ref to="1B4"></level-ref> needed one object sharp. Here there are two markers, the near one at 1200 mm and the far one at 2000 mm; the lens is focused at 1500 mm and stays there. The aperture is now given the photographer's way: the <wiki-ref to="f-number"></wiki-ref> is the focal length over the aperture diameter, so f/2 on a 50 mm lens is a 25 mm aperture.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：近处和远处两个物体，怎样在一张照片里都清晰？曲线画出每个深度的模糊圈和清晰的门槛。两个标记都清晰、进光量又不低于 1，才算对。
t.en: This level asks: how can a near and a far object both be sharp in one photo? The curve draws each depth's blur circle against the sharpness threshold. It is right when both markers are sharp and the light is at least 1.

after.zh: 同时清晰的深度范围叫<wiki-ref to="depth-of-field"></wiki-ref>：光圈越小、f 数越大，它越深，进来的光也越少。
after.en: The range of depths sharp at once is the <wiki-ref to="depth-of-field"></wiki-ref>: the smaller the aperture, the larger the f-number, the deeper it is and the less light comes in.

brief.zh: 对焦不动，选一档光圈：两个标记都清晰，进光量不低于 1。
brief.en: With the focus fixed, choose an aperture: both markers sharp and the light at least 1.

hint.zh: 比较两档光圈下，曲线低于门槛的那一段有多宽。
hint.en: Compare how wide the stretch of the curve below the threshold is at two apertures.

why.zh: 为了亮把光圈开到最大：清晰范围收窄到对焦处附近，两个标记都落在范围外。
why.en: Opening the aperture fully for light: the sharp range narrows around the focus and both markers fall outside it.

why.zh: 光圈收到最小：两个标记都清晰了，进光量却只剩约 0.27。
why.en: Closing the aperture all the way: both markers are sharp, but the light drops to about 0.27.
